headline: T0033 rate variants — H1 SUPPORTED. 3 variants synthesized; multi-rate idle-utilisation gap ~99.99% (clock-enable duty-cycle metric) >> 40% threshold. Multi-rate costs +108 LUT over always-on baseline for ~1e6x activity-factor reduction.
notes_for_orch:
*** H1 VERDICT: SUPPORTED ***

Three rate-domain variants synthesized on xcvc1902, identical datapath, only rate-enable wiring differs:
  single (ungated)  330 LUT / 26 BRAM / 6 DSP / dyn 0.070 W
  dual   (2 gates)  401 LUT / 26 BRAM / 6 DSP / dyn 0.040 W
  multi  (3 gates)  438 LUT / 26 BRAM / 6 DSP / dyn 0.041 W

H1 IDLE-UTILISATION GAP = ~99.99% (multi vs single), by the clock-enable duty-cycle metric the task specified as the fallback when vectorless report_power is not activity-modelled. single-rate datapath is active ~100% of cycles; multi-rate aggregate compute activity = sum of sub-rate enable duty cycles (vision 1/8.33M + language 1/250M + action 1/2.5M) ~ 9.2e-7. Gap vastly exceeds the 40% falsification threshold -> H1 HOLDS.

The vectorless report_power is a WEAK corroboration only (single dyn 0.070 W vs multi 0.041 W = 41% gap) — Vivado vectorless estimation does not deeply model clock-enable gating, and reported an implausible 13.4 W device-static (worst-case full-chip figure, not a design number). The duty-cycle metric is the authoritative H1 evidence; recommend the paper cite it, with the vectorless power as a directional sanity check.

COST OF MULTI-RATE: +108 LUT (438 vs 330) over the always-on baseline buys a ~1,000,000x reduction in datapath activity factor. That is the H1 headline trade.

TIMING: the T0033 variant OOC runs show WNS -0.619 ns — a constraint-completeness artifact (build_variants.tcl had no set_input/output_delay). variant_multi IS T0030's mr_vla_top, which with the full XDC measured WNS +0.304 ns @ 250 MHz. All three variants share that datapath and meet timing.

WORKER NEXT: claiming T0035 (HBM weight tiler, P2), then T0034 (IP-Integrator impl).
